new.n: Second Ward bathing beach and warming houses, Eau Claire River (1920s-30s)
new.pl: South bank of the Eau Claire River just west of Summer St, Eau Claire: city land given by the Northwestern Lumber Co. (today's city parcel at 1036 E Grand Ave runs along this bank)
new.st: Second Ward bathing beach and warming houses on the Eau Claire River. In April 1932 Northern States Power offered the city a 1,600 ft, 5-acre strip along the south bank from Summer St east to about 50 ft past Margaret St extended; its west end abutted the city-owned ground west of Summer St "which includes the ground on which the Second Ward bathing beach and warming houses are located", donated by the Northwestern Lumber Co. a few years before. Warming houses mean winter skating as well as summer swimming. A 1916 plan for a bathing beach at Electric Park (Wisconsin-Minnesota Light & Power) is a separate spot, location unknown. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
new.t: Wade the old beach shallows and work the bank and the warming-house lot; summer and winter crowds both drop coins. City park land: ask the city.
